raw.ItemConsumerBullet01: PREMIUM ENGINEERING: Lew’s KVD Elite size 200 spinning fishing reel features a lightweight C40 carbon frame, sideplates, and rotor, and a double-anodized, braid-ready aluminum spool for durability
raw.ItemConsumerBullet02: SMOOTH REELING: A premium 7-bearing system featuring high quality, shielded stainless steel bearings and a Zero Reverse one-way clutch bearing, deliver superior smoothness, power, and durability
raw.ItemConsumerBullet03: RELIABLE RETRIEVING: The reel recovers 31-inches of line per turn with its 6.2:1 gear ratio. Its reversible retrieve system offers a personalized fishing experience
raw.ItemConsumerBullet04: EFFORTLESS FISHING: A screw-in style threaded aluminum handle enhances balance and strength. A hybrid carbon fiber drag system delivers 16-pounds of smooth, consistent drag performance
raw.ItemConsumerBullet05: TOP-RATED VERSATILITY: The reel has a line capacity of 230-yards of 6-pound-test fluorocarbon or 280-yards of 8-pound-test braided fishing line
raw.ItemCopy:
The KVD Elite Spinning Reel combines innovation and precision, making it a trusted choice for dedicated anglers. Designed to be versatile yet excel in finesse fishing, the C40 carbon frame and sideplate makes this reel extremely light in weight to enhance bite sensitivity and feel great throughout a full day of fishing. Its lightweight design incorporates a double anodized braid-ready aluminum spool, offering durability while keeping weight to a minimum. Power and control come from the hybrid carbon drag system, which delivers smooth, consistent performance in any fishing scenario. This reel is exceptionally smooth with a premium stainless steel 7-bearing system, while the Zero Reverse® one-way clutch bearing offers precise hooksets every time. 

The KVD Elite Spinning Reel is offered in both full spool and shallow spool models. Full spool models allow for maximum line capacity for anglers that need it, while the shallow spool model provides ample line capacity for most anglers while eliminating the need for backing and wasted line, as well as providing extremely smooth line lay and extended casting distance."

raw.ItemConsumerProductTitle: Quantum Benchmark Spinning Fishing Reel, Size 2500 Reel, 5+1 Bearings, 6.2:1 Gear Ratio, Aluminum Frame, SEALOQ 6 Protection, GEARTEQ Machined Gears, CFX200 Carbon Fiber Xtreme Drag, Silver/Blue
raw.ItemConsumerBullet01: EXCEPTIONAL SPINNING REEL: Innovation and quality are engineered throughout every gear, seal, and feature of the new Quantum Benchmark spinning reel: the perfect choice when fishing in brackish or saltwater settings. A sturdy aluminum frame keeps all gears and bearings in perfect alignment, enhancing the reel’s durability and longevity. Its reversible handle is compatible with both left- and right-hand retrieve, offering a customizable fishing experience
raw.ItemConsumerBullet02: SEALED DESIGN: The Benchmark reel features SEALOQ 6 protection, which fully seals (rated to IPX6) the body and spool and actively protects internal components from water, salt, sand, and other debris. This SEALOQ 6 system enhances durability and promotes longevity, so you can do battle with saltwater predators like snook, redfish, speckled trout, calico bass, salmon, and striped bass for many seasons
raw.ItemConsumerBullet03: EXCEPTIONAL PERFORMANCE: Five stainless steel ball bearings enable smooth performance for the life of reel, while a DURA-LOQ clutch bearing ensures quick and powerful hooksets to land more fish. Providing exceptional strength and fish-stopping power, the CFX200 Carbon Fiber Xtreme drag system provides 20-pounds max drag with an impressive drag curve
raw.ItemConsumerBullet04: BUILT TO DOMINATE: The Benchmark features GEARTEQ™ machined gearing, precisely cut to tight tolerances and comprised of premium aluminum and brass to achieve high cranking power and exceptional gear feel. A 6.2:1 gear ratio enables 33-inches of line recovery per turn, all in a robust, fully sealed package. The reel’s forged aluminum spool holds 210-yards of 8-pound-test monofilament or 275-yards of 10-pound-test braided fishing line
raw.ItemConsumerBullet05: ROCK SOLID RELIABILITY: Anglers who hit the water with the Quantum Benchmark reel fish with the confidence that their gear is backed by a one-year limited warranty and supported by the dedicated Customer Service team at Quantum
raw.ItemCopy: Innovation and quality are engineered throughout every gear, seal, and feature of the Quantum Benchmark™ spinning reel. Offered in 6 sizes to catch anything from Trout to Tarpon, these spinning reels are built to the highest quality standards. The Benchmark reels have a sturdy aluminum frame, keeping all gears and bearings in perfect alignment, and are fully sealed with SEALOQ™ 6 protection to protect internal components from water, salt, and sand, ensuring long-lasting performance. The GEARTEQ™ Machined Gearing is precisely cut to tight tolerances and is comprised of premium materials to achieve extreme cranking power while maintaining exceptional gear feel.
